commits.subject: core: fix numeric conversion overflow and malformed decimal input
commits.body: Check signed integer and Currency bounds, exponent arithmetic and decimal grammar while preserving current handling of ordinary values and NaN/Inf. Keep regression coverage in NumericalConversions.
commits.author: Mike

commits.subject: crypt: support original Keccak-256
commits.body: Add a separate mode with the original padding and binary/hex digest helpers. Preserve existing algorithm ordinals and SHA-3/SHAKE behavior; cover reference hashes, block boundaries and incremental input.
commits.author: Mike

commits.subject: net: fixed GPF or deadlock in TDhcpProcess.Setup()
commits.body: - when some existing configuration is updated, a dangling pointer on the previous scope instances could be kept instead of the newly allocated array
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez
